raw_response:
A is well-posed only as a within-Window6 diagnostic, not as a genuine bridge back to bio  $E_1$ .
There is a clean pure-math object:

$$X_6=\{x\in\{0,1\}^6:\text{no adjacent 1s}\},
\quad |X_6|=21.$$

Embed it in the Boolean Hamming cube  $Q_6$  and take the centered indicator

$$f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64.$$

Use the Boolean Fourier decomposition

$$f_W=\sum_{S\subseteq[6]}\hat f(S)\chi_S.$$

Define its degree-energy profile

$$\rho_k(W)=
\frac{\sum_{|S|=k}\hat f(S)^2}
{\sum_{S\neq\varnothing}\hat f(S)^2},
\quad k=1,\ldots,6.$$

That is the exact Window6 analogue of “spectral order”: degree 1 is additive/single-coordinate, degree 2 is pairwise interaction, higher degrees are increasingly nonlinear constraints.
But this does not share a spectral frame with codon  $E_1$ . Codon  $E_1$  is the first Krawtchouk layer of  $H(3,4)=V_4^3$ , meaning single codon-position additive chemistry. Window6 Fourier degree 1 is single bit dependence in  $Q_6$ . These are both “first-order” only at the abstract level of product association schemes. They are not the same space, not the same coordinates, and not connected by a certified non-circular map.
So a Window6 degree-profile test can say:
Window6 itself is first-order-dominated, pairwise-dominated, or higher-order-dominated as a Boolean constraint.
It cannot say:
Window6 explains why the bio residual lives in codon  $E_1$ .
To make that stronger, one would have to group six Boolean coordinates into three  $V_4$ -like coordinates. But there is no canonical grouping. Any pairing of bits into codon positions would be an imported map, and the earlier non-q6 embedding failures already warn that this is where circularity enters. If one chooses a pairing because it makes Window6 resemble codon  $E_1$ , the result is invalid.
The only admissible version of A is therefore a negative-control audit:
Object:  $f_W=\mathbf{1}_{X_6}-21/64$  on  $Q_6$ .
Statistic:

$$D_W=(\rho_1,\rho_2,\rho_3,\rho_4,\rho_5,\rho_6),$$

with primary coordinates  $\rho_1$  and  $\rho_{\ge2}=1-\rho_1$ . If desired, use entropy of the degree profile,

$$H_W=-\sum_k\rho_k\log\rho_k,$$

as a concentration score.
Null:

$$\Omega_{21,38}
=
\{S\subset Q_6: |S|=21,\ e(S)=38\},$$

where  $e(S)$  is the number of internal cube edges. This controls the two most obvious Window6 facts: vertex count and edge count. A stricter null also fixes the six coordinate marginals, or at least their multiset, because first-order energy is strongly tied to coordinate imbalance.
Test:

$$p_1=\Pr_{S\sim\Omega_{21,38}}\left[\rho_1(S)\ge\rho_1(W)\right]$$

for first-order dominance, and

$$p_{\ge2}=\Pr_{S\sim\Omega_{21,38}}\left[\rho_{\ge2}(S)\ge\rho_{\ge2}(W)\right]$$

for higher-order dominance.
Certified means: Window6 has an extreme Boolean degree profile under the matched null, and the result survives coordinate-marginal conditioning.
Coincidence means: the degree profile is typical once size, edge count, and coordinate marginals are fixed.
But even if certified, it certifies only a property of Window6. It does not bridge to codon  $E_1$ . At most, it can extend the inverse-analogy rhetorically:


If Window6 is high-order or pairwise-dominated while bio  $B^*_{Q6}$  is codon- $E_1$ -dominated, that reinforces contrast: Window6 is a constraint language, the bio residual is additive chemistry.


If Window6 is also first-order-dominated, that is not a bridge unless a common coordinate map is independently forced.


If the result depends on grouping bits into three codon-like pairs, it is q6-circular or convention-circular.


So my honest answer is:
A is not a non-vacuous bridge step. It is only a possible sanity check on Window6’s own Fourier degree profile.
The spectral direction has now produced a clean negative result against the hoped bridge. The bio residual did not land in  $E_3$ . It landed in  $E_1$ , and specifically in position-3/position-1 weak-strong and purine-pyrimidine chemistry. That is biologically ordinary and structurally important, but it is not Fibonacci/Window6 structure. It says the signal lives in additive codon chemistry, not in the exotic high-frequency layer.
Therefore:
the bridge is correctly bio-gated; the decisive next input is the expanded organism set for the held-out cross-organism gate.
There is no remaining pure-math/public-data step that can honestly convert the certified  $E_1$  bio residual back into a Window6/Fibonacci bridge without smuggling in a coordinate map. The structural program is genuinely exhausted except for negative-control documentation.
The sharpest next question is:
In a larger held-out organism panel, does the certified codon- $E_1$  wobble/position-1 residual remain a reproducible biological axis after tRNA-tAI, TE, clade, and composition controls, or is it only a codon-spelling artifact?
